title: Mixing: What A Bastard The World Is, I Want My Love To Rest Tonight by Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

Two songs on Yoko Ono‘s third album Approximately Infinite Universe were mixed on 21 November 1972, with John Lennon co-producing.

‘What A B*****d The World Is’ had first been recorded on 19 October, and was re-recorded on 24 and 26 October, and mixed on 5 November. However, strings were added on 20 November, and the song was finally mixed on this day.

‘I Want My Love To Rest Tonight’ was first recorded on 23 October. It was remade on 26 October, and mixed on 5 and 11 November. Again, strings had been overdubbed on 20 November before the final mixes were made during this session.
